searchText: Hello, is this a correct understanding of the DAS block structure? I think using the word "kzg proof" instead of "kzg commitment" makes more sense. icydk, the data of each sample is exactly 496 bytes (16 field elements with 31 bytes each). It's 31 bytes not 32 bytes, because the field modulus is already 32 bytes. If we allow the data to be 32 bytes, the data can be more than the modulus so we can make it only 31 bytes. https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/blob/dev/specs/sharding/beacon-chain.md#misc Other than that, the numbers are approximately correct. Great, thanks. I will fix those points
